datasets.description: Niger Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/niger_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2020 in Niger. The classifications were spatially mapped to administrative and livelihood zones to represent food insecurity phases (IPC 1-5) under different scenarios, providing medium-term projections of acute food insecurity impacts on the population.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas.
